sources.title: Drake Maye not expected to play in Patriots preseason opener

sources.title: Drake Maye unlikely to play preseason opener vs. Colts
sources.description: Patriots quarterback Drake Maye is unlikely to play in the team's preseason opener against the Colts on Thursday night, head coach Mike Vrabel said in his Tuesday press conference.
